title: The Clear Quran, Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.21:1: [The time of] people’s judgment has drawn near, yet they are heedlessly turning away
verses.1:6: Guide us along the Straight Path
verses.102:1-2: (1) Competition for more [gains] diverts you [from Allah] (2) until you end up in [your] graves
verses.18:110: Say, [O Prophet,] “I am only a man like you, [but] it has been revealed to me that your God is only One God. So whoever hopes for the meeting with their Lord, let them do good deeds and associate none in the worship of their Lord.”
verses.67:2: [He is the One] Who created death and life in order to test which of you is best in deeds. And He is the Almighty, All-Forgiving
verses.100:6-8: (6) Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord— (7) and they certainly attest to this— (8) and they are truly extreme in their love of [worldly] gains
verses.101:4: [It is] the Day people will be like scattered moths
verses.103:1-3: (1) By the [passage of] time (2) Surely humanity is in [grave] loss (3) except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance
verses.104:2-3: (2) who amasses wealth [greedily] and counts it [repeatedly] (3) thinking that their wealth will make them immortal
verses.105:1-2: (1) Have you not seen [O Prophet] how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant (2) Did He not frustrate their scheme
verses.31:14: And We have commanded people to [honour] their parents. Their mothers bore them through hardship upon hardship, and their weaning takes two years. So be grateful to Me and your parents. To Me is the final return
verses.17:32: Do not go near adultery. It is truly a shameful deed and an evil way
verses.24:30: [O Prophet!] Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and guard their chastity. That is purer for them. Surely Allah is All-Aware of what they do
verses.28:81: Then We caused the earth to swallow him up, along with his home. There was no one to help him against Allah, nor could he even help himself
verses.2:219: They ask you [O Prophet] about intoxicants and gambling. Say, “There is great evil in both, as well as some benefit for people—but the evil outweighs the benefit.” They [also] ask you [O Prophet] what they should donate. Say, “Whatever you can spare.” This is how Allah makes His revelations clear to you [believers], so perhaps you may reflect
verses.4:43: O believers! Do not approach prayer while intoxicated until you are aware of what you say, nor in a state of [full] impurity—unless you merely pass through [the mosque]—until you have bathed. But if you are ill, on a journey, or have relieved yourselves, or been intimate with your wives and cannot find water, then purify yourselves with clean earth, wiping your faces and hands. And Allah is Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving
verses.5:91: Satan’s plan is to stir up hostility and hatred between you with intoxicants and gambling and to prevent you from remembering Allah and praying. Will you not then abstain
verses.15:99: and worship your Lord until the inevitable comes your way
verses.74:38: Every soul will be detained for what it has done
verses.75:36: Do people think they will be left without purpose
verses.78:40: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see [the consequences of] what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
